title: The Streetwear Capsule: 12 Pieces, 50 Outfits
description: A full closet and nothing to wear? A capsule wardrobe fixes it. Twelve pieces, one colour logic, and dozens of combinations that always work.
excerpt: The problem isn't how much you own — it's that none of it talks to each other. A capsule turns a pile into a system.
content:
Your closet is packed and you still stand in front of it for ten minutes every morning. The problem is almost never quantity. It's that nothing you own talks to anything else. A capsule wardrobe fixes that with a simple trade: fewer pieces, far more combinations.

## Start with colour, not clothes

Pick two neutrals as your base — black and grey, or sand and navy — plus one accent you actually enjoy wearing. The rule is brutally simple: every new piece has to carry one of those three colours. Follow it and everything matches everything, automatically. This step costs nothing and does about 80% of the work.

## The twelve pieces that cover you

Three tees, two hoodies or crewnecks, one overshirt or jacket, two pairs of trousers (one wide, one straight), one pair of shorts, and two pairs of shoes — one clean white, one dark. The twelfth piece is your statement: the loud jacket or graphic tee people recognise you in. Do the maths — three tops × two bottoms × two shoes is already twelve looks before you start layering.

## Quality beats quantity here

A capsule only works if the pieces survive weekly wear. One well-made hoodie from a curated shop like [DOPESTORE](https://dopestore.cz) outlasts three fast-fashion ones that pill after a season. Cheaper per wear, even if the receipt says otherwise.

## Wear it, don't archive it

A capsule isn't a museum. Shoot a few combinations on your phone so mornings need zero thinking. And if you post your fits, [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz) helps push the reach.

Set the colour logic, buy only the gaps, donate the rest. In a month you'll dress better and decide faster.
